formulas.expression: IF( AND( MONTH( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) = 2, DAY( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) = 29, NOT( OR( MOD( YEAR( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ), 400 ) = 0, AND( MOD( YEAR( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ), 4 ) = 0, MOD( YEAR( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ), 100 ) != 0 ) ) ) ), DATE( YEAR( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) + 1, 3, 1), DATE( YEAR( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) + 1, MONTH( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ), DAY( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) ) )

formulas.name: BiennialIncreaseDate
formulas.expression: IF( AND( MONTH( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) = 2, DAY( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) = 29, NOT( OR( MOD( YEAR( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ), 400 ) = 0, AND( MOD( YEAR( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ), 4 ) = 0, MOD( YEAR( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ), 100 ) != 0 ) ) ) ), DATE( YEAR( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) + 2, 3, 1), DATE( YEAR( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) + 2, MONTH( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ), DAY( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) ) )

formulas.name: BimonthlyIncreaseDate
formulas.expression: DATE( YEAR( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) + FLOOR( ( MONTH ( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) + 2 - 1 ) / 12 ), MOD( MONTH ( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) + 2 - 1 + IF( DAY ( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) > CASE( MOD( MONTH( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) + 2 - 1, 12 ) + 1, 2, 28, 4, 30, 6, 30, 9, 30, 11, 30, 31 ), 1, 0 ), 12 ) + 1, IF( DAY( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) > CASE( MOD( MONTH( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) + 2 - 1, 12 ) + 1, 2, 28, 4, 30, 6, 30, 9, 30, 11, 30, 31 ), 1, DAY( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) ) )

formulas.name: MonthlyIncreaseDate
formulas.expression: DATE( YEAR( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) + FLOOR( ( MONTH ( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) + 1 - 1 ) / 12 ), MOD( MONTH ( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) + 1 - 1 + IF( DAY ( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) > CASE( MOD( MONTH( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) + 1 - 1, 12 ) + 1, 2, 28, 4, 30, 6, 30, 9, 30, 11, 30, 31 ), 1, 0 ), 12 ) + 1, IF( DAY( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) > CASE( MOD( MONTH( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) + 1 - 1, 12 ) + 1, 2, 28, 4, 30, 6, 30, 9, 30, 11, 30, 31 ), 1, DAY( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) ) )

formulas.name: QuarterlyIncreaseDate
formulas.expression: DATE( YEAR( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) + FLOOR( ( MONTH ( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) + 3 - 1 ) / 12 ), MOD( MONTH ( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) + 3 - 1 + IF( DAY ( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) > CASE( MOD( MONTH( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) + 3 - 1, 12 ) + 1, 2, 28, 4, 30, 6, 30, 9, 30, 11, 30, 31 ), 1, 0 ), 12 ) + 1, IF( DAY( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) > CASE( MOD( MONTH( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) + 3 - 1, 12 ) + 1, 2, 28, 4, 30, 6, 30, 9, 30, 11, 30, 31 ), 1, DAY( {!Screen_Recurring_Payment_Start_Date} ) ) )
